remarks: Charming Raised Ranch on a Corner Lot in the Coveted Cranbury Section of Norwalk! Discover the perfect blend of comfort and potential in this delightful 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath raised ranch nestled on a desirable corner lot in the sought-after Cranbury neighborhood. This home is making its debut on the market for the first time in 35 years offering a rare opportunity for new owners to infuse their creative vision. Step inside to find a spacious living room adorned with vaulted ceilings creating an open and airy atmosphere. The living room seamlessly flows into the dining room making it an ideal space for entertaining family and friends. Beautiful hardwood floors extend throughout the first floor adding warmth and elegance to the living areas. The primary bedroom serves as a private retreat complete with its own full bathroom for added convenience. Venture down to the lower level where a large open family room or rec room awaits perfect for relaxation, play, or hosting gatherings. This versatile space also features interior garage access, enhancing functionality and ease of living.  With its prime location in the desirable Cranbury section, this home is close to parks, schools, and local amenities, making it perfect for families and professionals alike. Bring your creative touch to this charming raised ranch and transform it into your dream home. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity schedule your showing today! Highest & Best due by Wednesday 10/2 at 7PM.
